name: local-first-collaborative-workspace
author: Simon Wen
description: A local-first collaborative document workspace with offline editing, realtime synchronization, and deterministic convergence.

scripts.dev:server: npm run build -w @lfcw/crdt && npm run build -w @lfcw/protocol && npm run dev -w @lfcw/server
scripts.build: npm run build -w @lfcw/crdt && npm run build -w @lfcw/protocol && npm run build -w @lfcw/server && npm run build -w @lfcw/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @lfcw/crdt && npm run typecheck -w @lfcw/protocol && npm run typecheck -w @lfcw/server && npm run typecheck -w @lfcw/web && npm run typecheck:e2e
